inputs.text: Well, folks, we are seeing it with our own eyes once again. Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday for this so-called Together Alliance event, billed as the biggest [...] just weeks ahead of key local elections. This comes six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations. This radical mob of trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies is out in the streets attempting to disrupt our traditional social order, undermine our heritage, and bully the public right before they head to the ballot box. Instead of promoting personal responsibility and preserving time-tested British values, these progressive agitators are manufacturing division and pandering to special interests to seize political power. We have got to stand firm for cultural continuity and law and order against this constant pressure.
